payload.core_mechanism_summary: Try all positions and a few candidate replacement values (neighbors and neighbors ±1) to find best single-element change that reduces intimidation count.
payload.rationale: The code performs a brute-force search over O(n) positions, each trying up to 6 candidate values for the modified element, simulating local hill/valley changes. No recursive backtracking or advanced search is used, but among given subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest match due to trial-and-revert behavior.
